trailhead.label: Panider Sattel / Passo Pinei, Pas Pinëi bus stop (line 172)

waypoints.label: Drinking fountain by Pufels church (about 115 m off the path)

cautions: Start beside the Panider Sattel pass road (SP64).
About 1.2 km on tarmac: access lane and Pufels farm and village roads with local traffic.
Short flight of steps on the upper path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
